context: A year-end recap of the program
purpose: Recap the year; teach １月/３月/５月/７月/日間/９月/２つ/１つ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今年のイベント、全部終わりましたね。
lines.en: This year’s events are all done.
lines.style: relieved planner reflecting fondly, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: １月のフェアから始まって、長い一年だった。
lines.en: Starting from the January fair, it was a long year.
lines.style: reflective manager looking back, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ３月、５月、と季節ごとに開催できました。
lines.en: March, May — we held one each season.
lines.style: satisfied planner tallying the wins, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ７月の夏祭りは、二日間とも大盛況。
lines.en: The July festival packed both days.
lines.style: proud manager recalling the peak, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ９月は２つ同時で大変でしたけど。
lines.en: September was tough with two at once.
lines.style: candid planner admitting the strain, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 来年は、目玉をもう１つ増やそうか。
lines.en: Next year, shall we add one more highlight?
lines.style: ambitious manager planning ahead, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
